hooks.name: Block writes under tests/
hooks.description: Blocks any file write, replace, or push targeting a path under tests/ before the tool runs.

action.command: $input = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $path = $input.tool_input.path; if ($path -match 'tests[\\/]') { Write-Error 'Writes to tests/ are blocked by policy. Get explicit approval before modifying test files.'; exit 2 }
